lines.speaker: trader_sable
lines.text: Your machine's been staring at the relay mast for an hour. Hasn't blinked once, which I appreciate is not a thing it does.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: It is my channel. Assigned to the second office in 2088 and never reassigned. I have been the only thing on it since the racks came down, and for the whole of that time I have been saying one line incorrectly.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: I would like to say it correctly. Once. On the channel it was meant for. I am aware of how that sounds and I would like to do it anyway.
